answer: No piece crosses the gate without its maker walking beside it, and the gatekeeper knows every maker by sight. Proof of chandler wick via wax chandlers company is the gatekeeper's rule: a wick the wax chandlers company dips only after the chandler pours a candle he actually dipped. The vine is the gate itself, shut to strangers; the saffron is the token the maker shows; the tide is the book where every crossing is written. A cheat needs 43 forged tokens and 43 forged entries, and the book still has no line in his hand.
